title: PAR-07/S8.3 modeler raw-frame ownership transfer fast slice
scope: Avoid one deep copy of the parsed DWG frame for REGION, 3DSOLID, and BODY typed modeler values
Preserve the separate byte-identical raw companion and its const-reference callback
Verify generated modeler/raw frame equality, identity, owner, and AcDs payload association

implementation.behavior: After parsing and AcDs linking, REGION/3DSOLID/BODY move the object-frame body vector into DRW_ModelerGeometry. makeRawEntity copies the raw companion from that owned typed frame, and the raw companion then moves into the owned output journal event. Other makeRawEntity callers retain the previous default source.
implementation.copyBoundary: Removes the typed entity's former full-frame deep copy. A separate raw callback snapshot remains necessary and is compared byte-for-byte with the typed frame. Journal staging is already move-based from the preceding slice. Consumer retention and AcDs section-to-entity payload copies remain.

commands.command: git diff --check -- DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md src/intern/dwgreader.cpp tests/dwg_reader_matrix_tests.cpp docs/research/datastorage-modeler-raw-frame-ownership-transfer-fast-slice-2026-10-18.json

assessment.limitations: This is a focused in-memory copy-boundary optimization, not a throughput/RSS benchmark or semantic evidence. No external format, AcDs, B-rep, or native-consumer claim is promoted.
